<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ja">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge,chrome=1">
    <title>404 | SUZURI</title>

    <script src="https://aframe.io/releases/1.0.0/aframe.min.js"></script>
    <script>
      AFRAME.registerComponent('navigate-on-click', {
        schema: {
          url: {default: ''}
        },

        init: function () {
          var data = this.data;
          var el = this.el;

          el.addEventListener('click', function () {
            window.location.href = data.url;
          });
        }
      });
    </script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <a-scene>
      <a-assets>
        <a-assets-item id="surisuri-obj" src="/surisuri3d/tinker.obj"></a-assets-item>
        <a-assets-item id="surisuri-mtl" src="/surisuri3d/obj.mtl"></a-assets-item>
      </a-assets>

      <a-obj-model
        src="#surisuri-obj"
        mtl="#surisuri-mtl"
        position="0.1 3 -5"
        scale="0.03 0.03 0.03"
        rotation="-80 0 0"
        animation="property: rotation; dur: 10000; fill: forwards; from: -80 0 0; to: -80 0 360; easing: linear; loop: true">
      </a-obj-model>
      <a-text value="404" color="#231815" align="center" wrap-count="5" position="0 2 -5"></a-text>
      <a-text value="The page you were looking for doesn't exist." color="#231815" align="center" wrap-count="40" position="0 0.5 -5"></a-text>
      <a-text value="Return to the home page" color="#231815" align="center" wrap-count="40" position="0 -0.5 -5"
        navigate-on-click="url: /"
        cursor="rayOrigin: mouse"
        event-set__enter="_event: mouseenter;"
        event-set__leave="_event: mouseleave;"
        >
      </a-text>
      <a-entity id="camera" camera="" position="0 1.6 0" look-controls cursor="rayOrigin: mouse"></a-entity>

      <a-obj-model
        src="#surisuri-obj"
        mtl="#surisuri-mtl"
        position="0.4 0 4"
        scale="0.01 0.01 0.01"
        rotation="-90 0 180"
        animation="property: position; dur: 100; fill: forwards; from: 0.4 0 4; to: 0.4 0.15 4; easing: linear; loop: true">
      </a-obj-model>

      <a-sky color="#f4f4f4"></a-sky>
    </a-scene>
  </body>
</html>
